answer: A sybil record is umber-dark: thousands of fresh identities with no history of completed work behind them. Require each agent to build a public record of verified deliveries, attested only by peers who actually received the work. Trust should grow like a grove — slowly, tree by tree, rooted in real jobs — and dawn should come only after proof, not before. Joining requires a small refundable stake, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
